mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_coupon (name, type, condition_amount, discount_amount, total_count, received_count, used_count, per_user_limit, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{conditionAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{totalCount}, #{receivedCount}, #{usedCount}, #{perUserLimit}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM stellar_coupon c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.received_count < c.total_count AND NOW() BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time AND ( c.per_user_limit IS NULL OR c.per_user_limit <= 0 OR ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stellar_user_coupon uc WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.coupon_id = c.id ) < c.per_user_limit ) ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE stellar_coupon SET received_count = received_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND received_count < total_count
UPDATE stellar_coupon SET used_count = used_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, status, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{userId}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE stellar_user_coupon SET status = 1, order_id = NULL, used_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
UPDATE stellar_coupon SET used_count = GREATEST(used_count - 1, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT uc.*, c.name AS coupon_name, c.type AS coupon_type, c.condition_amount, c.discount_amount, c.start_time, c.end_time FROM stellar_user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN stellar_coupon c ON c.id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.id = #{id}

SELECT uc.*, c.name AS coupon_name, c.type AS coupon_type, c.condition_amount, c.discount_amount, c.start_time, c.end_time FROM stellar_user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN stellar_coupon c ON c.id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stellar_user_coupon WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId}

SELECT uc.*, c.name AS coupon_name, c.type AS coupon_type, c.condition_amount, c.discount_amount, c.start_time, c.end_time FROM stellar_user_coupon uc LEFT JOIN stellar_coupon c ON c.id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.status = 0 AND c.end_time IS NOT NULL AND c.end_time BETWEEN #{now} AND #{deadline} ORDER BY c.end_time ASC
